items.text_en: What kind of butterfly is this? Has anyone else seen one like mine?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi loại bướm lạ bắt gặp trong game.

items.text_en: What is the pink box that I haven't opened?

items.text_vn: Muốn biết có bảng cá quái vật (monster) không ạ, mệt quá rồi huhu
items.text_en: I'd like to know if there is a monster fish chart. I'm exhausted!
items.summary_vn: Xin bảng thông tin cá quái vật vì câu mãi mệt.
items.summary_en: Asks for a monster fish chart because fishing is exhausting.

items.text_en: Do people sell accounts for this game?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi có ai bán tài khoản game không.
items.summary_en: Asks whether accounts are sold.

items.text_vn: Tìm bạn boost vườn, mình cũng muốn được 15% như người ta 🤣
items.text_en: Looking for friends to boost my garden — I want the 15% bonus too 🤣
items.summary_vn: Tìm bạn boost vườn để nhận thêm 15%.
items.summary_en: Looks for friends to boost the garden for a 15% bonus.

items.text_th: รถตุ๊กตุ๊ก ไทย เฟี้ยวสุด😁
items.text_vn: Xe tuk tuk Thái ngầu hết cỡ 😁
items.text_en: The Thai tuk-tuk looks awesome 😁
items.summary_vn: Khen xe tuk tuk Thái trong sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Praises the Thai tuk-tuk from the event.

items.text_th: ชาวเวียดนามทำเควสจนเสร็จแล้วค่ะ เราที่เควสในจดหมายส้มยังไม่ขึ้นเลย
items.text_vn: Người chơi Việt đã làm xong nhiệm vụ rồi, còn mình thì nhiệm vụ trong thư cam vẫn chưa hiện ra
items.text_en: Vietnamese players have already finished the quest, but the quest in my orange letter still hasn't shown up.
items.summary_vn: Nhiệm vụ sự kiện trong thư cam chưa hiện ở máy người chơi Thái.
items.summary_en: The event quest in the orange letter hasn't appeared for this Thai player.

items.text_th: ไปเดินซื้อของของกิจกรรมรถตุ๊กตุ๊กวันนี้กันเถอะ TikTok : rukkung2000
items.text_vn: Hôm nay cùng đi mua đồ cho sự kiện xe tuk tuk nhé. TikTok: rukkung2000
items.text_en: Let's go shopping for today's tuk-tuk event items. TikTok: rukkung2000
items.summary_vn: Chia sẻ video hướng dẫn mua đồ cho sự kiện tuk tuk.
items.summary_en: Shares a guide video for shopping in the tuk-tuk event.

items.text_th: เฝ้าแต่สวนไง เกมบอกให้ออกมาแว๊นบ้าง🫩💕
items.text_vn: Cứ trông vườn suốt, game bảo ra ngoài đua xe chơi đi 🫩💕
items.text_en: I only ever stay in the garden — the game tells me to get out and go joyriding 🫩💕
items.summary_vn: Đùa rằng game nhắc ra ngoài chạy xe thay vì ở vườn.
items.summary_en: Jokes that the game tells them to leave the garden and ride.

items.text_th: ผมเปิดจดหมายส้มไม่ได้ เป็นอะไรเน้อ
items.text_vn: Mình không mở được thư cam, bị làm sao vậy nhỉ?
items.text_en: I can't open the orange letter. What's wrong?
items.summary_vn: Không mở được thư cam của sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Can't open the event's orange letter.

items.text_th: เราจะเข้าเกมได้ยังไงคะโหลดเวอชั่นใหม่มาอันเก่าลบทิ้งไปนานแล้ว
items.text_vn: Làm sao vào game được ạ? Mình tải phiên bản mới rồi mà bản cũ đã xóa từ lâu
items.text_en: How can I get into the game? I downloaded the new version, but I deleted the old one long ago.
items.summary_vn: Không vào được game bản VNG vì đã xóa bản cũ để lấy mã chuyển.
items.summary_en: Can't get into the VNG version because the old version was deleted.

items.text_th: มีใครรู้มั้ยคะทำไมรูปโปรไฟล์เกมหาย อยู่ๆก็หายค่ะไม่รู้ไปกดอะไรผิดไหม เกมเชื่อมเฟสกับเมลไว้ ถามทางเกมแล้วเขาแนะนำให้ลบเกมละโหลดใหม่ ทำแล้วก็ยังไม่ขึ้น มีใครรู้สาเหตุมั้ยคะ
items.text_vn: Ai biết vì sao ảnh đại diện trong game biến mất không ạ? Tự nhiên mất, không biết mình bấm nhầm gì không. Game liên kết Facebook và mail. Hỏi bên game thì họ bảo xóa game tải lại, làm rồi vẫn chưa hiện. Ai biết nguyên nhân không ạ?
items.text_en: Does anyone know why my in-game profile picture disappeared? It vanished suddenly. The game is linked to Facebook and email. Support told me to delete and reinstall, but it still doesn't show. Any idea why?
items.summary_vn: Ảnh đại diện trong game biến mất dù đã cài lại game.
items.summary_en: The in-game profile picture disappeared even after reinstalling.
items.published_label: ~00:32 05/11 (ước theo ID bài; bình luận đầu 01:52)

items.text_th: ทำผัดไทยตรงไหนหรอคะ
items.text_vn: Làm món pad thai ở đâu vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Where do I make the pad thai?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi chỗ làm pad thai trong nhiệm vụ sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Asks where to make the pad thai in the event quest.

items.text_th: เค้ามีนะคะ เผื่อสนใจทักมาดูภาพของเพิ่มเติมก่อนได้นะคะ
items.text_vn: Có đấy ạ, nếu quan tâm nhắn mình xem thêm ảnh đồ trước nhé
items.text_en: Yes, there are some. If you're interested, message me to see more photos first.
items.summary_vn: Người bán trả lời có bán tài khoản, mời nhắn tin.
items.summary_en: A seller replies that accounts are available and invites a DM.

items.text_th: โค้ดใส่ตรงไหนครับ ​
items.text_vn: Mã quà nhập ở đâu vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Where do I enter the code?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi nơi nhập mã quà.
items.summary_en: Asks where to enter the gift code.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: คือผีเสื้อ หางติ่ง จ้ะ ขายได้ราคาหลักร้อย+
items.text_vn: Đó là bướm đuôi nhọn (หางติ่ง) nhé, bán được vài trăm trở lên
items.text_en: It's a swallowtail butterfly; it sells for a few hundred or more.
items.summary_vn: Trả lời loại bướm và giá bán.
items.summary_en: Names the butterfly and its sale price.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ตัวใหญ่มาก จับได้มั้ยค่ะ
items.text_vn: To lắm, bắt được không ạ?
items.text_en: It's very big. Can it be caught?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi con bướm to có bắt được không.
items.summary_en: Asks whether the big butterfly can be caught.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เค้าเคยเจอนกค่ะตัวสีฟ้าๆ ลายเส้นคล้ายๆงี้ จับไม่ได้ดั้ว
items.text_vn: Mình từng gặp con chim màu xanh, hoa văn gần giống thế này, nhưng không bắt được
items.text_en: I once saw a blue bird with similar markings, but couldn't catch it.
items.summary_vn: Kể từng gặp con chim xanh tương tự nhưng không bắt được.
items.summary_en: Says they saw a similar blue bird but couldn't catch it.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เคยเจอผสมกันหลายตัวเลย
items.text_vn: Mình cũng từng gặp lẫn nhiều con kiểu như vậy
items.text_en: I've seen several mixed together too.
items.summary_vn: Từng gặp nhiều con lẫn nhau.
items.summary_en: Has seen several mixed together.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ของรางวัล เงินและเหรียญครับ
items.text_vn: Phần thưởng là tiền và xu ạ
items.text_en: The rewards are money and coins.
items.summary_vn: Trả lời hộp chứa tiền và xu.
items.summary_en: Answers that the box holds money and coins.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ถ้าเตงเปิด เตงจะจบกิจกรรมไวกว่านี้ค่ะ เสียดาย แง
items.text_vn: Nếu mở ra sớm thì mình đã xong sự kiện nhanh hơn rồi, tiếc quá huhu
items.text_en: If I had opened it, I'd have finished the event faster. What a shame, sob.
items.summary_vn: Tiếc vì không mở hộp sớm để xong sự kiện nhanh hơn.
items.summary_en: Regrets not opening the box earlier to finish the event sooner.

items.text_th: เข้าวันไหนนน
items.text_vn: Vào ngày nào vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Which day does it start?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi ngày bắt đầu sự kiện tuk tuk.
items.summary_en: Asks when the tuk-tuk event starts.

items.text_th: ดู ในกิจกรรม ไม่มี ค่ะ
items.text_vn: Mình xem trong mục sự kiện thì không thấy có ạ
items.text_en: I looked in the events section and it isn't there.
items.summary_vn: Không thấy sự kiện trong mục sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Can't find the event in the events section.

items.text_th: ตอนนี้ได้บางเครื่อง
items.text_vn: Hiện giờ chỉ một số máy là được thôi
items.text_en: Right now it only works on some devices.
items.summary_vn: Chỉ một số thiết bị hiện được nhiệm vụ.
items.summary_en: Only some devices get the quest right now.

items.text_th: ต้องเปลี่ยนเนตที่ใช้เล่นครับของผมก็ใช้ wifi บ้านไม่ได้ ถ้าใช้เนตมือถือถึงจะได้
items.text_vn: Phải đổi mạng đang dùng để chơi; mình dùng wifi nhà cũng không được, dùng mạng điện thoại mới được
items.text_en: You need to change the connection: home Wi-Fi didn't work for me, only mobile data did.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên đổi sang mạng di động vì wifi nhà không hiện nhiệm vụ.
items.summary_en: Advises switching to mobile data because home Wi-Fi didn't work.

items.text_th: ถ้าใครเล่น wifi แล้วมันไม่ขึ้น เราแนะนำให้แจ้ง เนต wifi ที่ตัวเองใช้นะคะ ให้เค้าเช็คสัญญาณ ของเราเคยเป็นแบบนี้ พอแจ้งเรื่องไป เค้าเปลี่ยนสัญญาณให้ เราก็ใช้ wifi เล่นได้ปกติเลยค่ะ
items.text_vn: Ai chơi bằng wifi mà không hiện thì nên báo nhà mạng kiểm tra tín hiệu. Mình từng bị vậy, báo xong họ đổi tín hiệu là chơi wifi bình thường
items.text_en: If it doesn't show on Wi-Fi, report it to your ISP to check the signal. It happened to me; after I reported it they changed the signal and Wi-Fi works normally.
items.summary_vn: Mách báo nhà mạng kiểm tra wifi để hiện được nhiệm vụ.
items.summary_en: Suggests asking the ISP to check Wi-Fi so the quest appears.

items.text_th: ข้อ2ทำไงครับ
items.text_vn: Câu 2 làm sao vậy ạ?
items.text_en: How do I do task 2?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi cách làm nhiệm vụ số 2.
items.summary_en: Asks how to do task 2.

items.text_th: แค่ซื้อไม่ต้องทำใช่ไหม ผัดไทย?
items.text_vn: Chỉ cần mua thôi, không cần làm đúng không? Pad thai ấy?
items.text_en: Do we just buy it without making it? The pad thai?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi chỉ cần mua nguyên liệu pad thai là đủ.
items.summary_en: Asks if buying pad thai ingredients is enough.

items.text_th: แล้วคำตอบข้อสุดท้ายเอามาจากไหนคะ
items.text_vn: Vậy đáp án câu cuối lấy ở đâu ạ?
items.text_en: Where do we get the answer to the last question?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi nơi tìm đáp án câu cuối.
items.summary_en: Asks where to find the final answer.

items.text_th: ได้รถตุ๊กๆแถมคนขับด้วยมั้ยคะ
items.text_vn: Có được tặng xe tuk tuk kèm cả tài xế không ạ?
items.text_en: Do we get the tuk-tuk with a driver too?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi phần thưởng có kèm tài xế không.
items.summary_en: Asks if the tuk-tuk reward comes with a driver.

items.text_th: ออนในไอแพตเอาค่ะ ฮือ
items.text_vn: Mình đành lên iPad chơi vậy, huhu
items.text_en: I'll just play on the iPad then, sob.
items.summary_vn: Đành chuyển sang iPad vì không thấy nhiệm vụ.
items.summary_en: Will switch to an iPad since the quest doesn't show.

items.text_th: มือถือก็ไม่ขึ้น ทำใงครับ
items.text_vn: Điện thoại cũng không hiện, phải làm sao ạ?
items.text_en: It doesn't show on my phone either. What should I do?
items.summary_vn: Nhiệm vụ không hiện cả trên điện thoại.
items.summary_en: The quest doesn't show on mobile either.

items.text_th: เค้าก็ไม่ขึ้นค่ะ สงสัยต้องรอ
items.text_vn: Của mình cũng không hiện, chắc phải chờ
items.text_en: Mine doesn't show up either; maybe we need to wait.
items.summary_vn: Thư cam chưa hiện, chắc phải chờ.
items.summary_en: The orange letter doesn't show; probably need to wait.

items.text_th: ต้องไปเอารหัสเพื่อลิ้งจากแอปเดิมมาแอปใหม่อย่างvngค่ะ | -เข้าapp store | -กดรูปโปรไฟล์ตัวเองมุมขวา | -กดapp&purchase หาแอปplaytoglobalที่เราเคยลบทิ้งไปโหลดกลับมาค่ะ | เข้าglobalได้ กดตั้งค่าแล้วมันจะมีให้รับลิ้งเชื่อมvngอยู่ล่างขวาค่ะ
items.text_vn: Phải lấy mã liên kết từ app cũ sang app mới (VNG). Vào App Store, bấm ảnh đại diện góc phải, vào App & Purchase, tìm app Play Together Global đã xóa và tải lại. Vào được bản Global thì bấm Cài đặt, góc dưới bên phải sẽ có nút nhận liên kết sang VNG.
items.text_en: You need to get the link code from the old app for the new VNG app: open the App Store, tap your profile picture at the top right, go to Apps & Purchases, find the Play Together Global app you deleted and download it again. Once you're in Global, open Settings and you'll find the VNG link option at the bottom right.
items.summary_vn: Hướng dẫn tải lại bản Global để lấy mã liên kết sang VNG.
items.summary_en: Explains how to reinstall Global to get the link code for VNG.

items.text_th: ถ้าตัวเองทำไมได้เค้ารับทำให้นะ เข้าไปรหัสเฉยๆ
items.text_vn: Nếu bạn không tự làm được thì mình nhận làm hộ, chỉ cần đăng nhập bằng mã thôi
items.text_en: If you can't do it yourself, I can do it for you — just log in with the code.
items.summary_vn: Chào mời làm hộ việc chuyển tài khoản.
items.summary_en: Offers to do the account transfer for them.

items.text_th: ขออนุญาตค่ะแอด ภารกิจจากตรงไหนหรอคะ
items.text_vn: Cho em hỏi admin, nhiệm vụ nhận từ đâu ạ?
items.text_en: Excuse me, admin — where do we get the mission from?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi nhận nhiệm vụ sự kiện ở đâu.
items.summary_en: Asks where to get the event mission.

items.text_th: ยังไม่เห็นเควสเลยครับ
items.text_vn: Mình vẫn chưa thấy nhiệm vụ nào cả
items.text_en: I still don't see the quest at all.
items.summary_vn: Chưa thấy nhiệm vụ sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Still can't see the event quest.

items.text_th: มะนาวอยู่ตรงไหนคะ TwT
items.text_vn: Chanh nằm ở đâu vậy ạ TwT
items.text_en: Where is the lime? TwT
items.summary_vn: Hỏi vị trí vật phẩm chanh trong nhiệm vụ.
items.summary_en: Asks where to find the lime for the quest.

items.text_th: ของเราไม่ขึ้นเลยค่ะ ต้องไปกดเข้ากิจตรงไหนคะ
items.text_vn: Của mình không hiện luôn ạ, phải vào sự kiện ở đâu vậy?
items.text_en: It doesn't show for me at all. Where do I tap to join the event?
items.summary_vn: Sự kiện không hiện, hỏi cách vào.
items.summary_en: The event doesn't show; asks how to join.

items.text_th: ในจดหมายส้ม ไม่มีอะไรเลยค่ะ
items.text_vn: Trong thư cam không có gì cả ạ
items.text_en: There's nothing in the orange letter.
items.summary_vn: Thư cam trống, không có nhiệm vụ.
items.summary_en: The orange letter is empty.

items.text_th: ข้อสุดท้ายต้องตอบอะไรคะมีใครตอบแล้วบ้าง
items.text_vn: Câu cuối phải trả lời gì vậy ạ, có ai trả lời chưa?
items.text_en: What is the answer to the last question? Has anyone answered it?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi đáp án câu cuối của nhiệm vụ.
items.summary_en: Asks for the final quest answer.

items.text_th: ใครที่จดหมดส้มไม่มีลองเปลี่ยนเนตที่ใช้เล่นครับ เช่นถ้าwifi ไม่ขึ้น ลองใช้ เนตมือถือ หรือลองใช้wifi จากที่อื่น ตอนกิจกรรมก่อนที่เป็นกิลด์ของผมก็กดด้วยเนตบ้านไม่ได้ ต้องใช้เนตมือถือ แต่ wifi บางทีก็กดได้
items.text_vn: Ai không có thư cam thì thử đổi mạng đang chơi, ví dụ wifi không hiện thì dùng mạng điện thoại hoặc wifi chỗ khác. Sự kiện trước (hội nhóm) mình cũng không bấm được bằng mạng nhà, phải dùng mạng di động, nhưng đôi khi wifi vẫn bấm được.
items.text_en: If you don't have the orange letter, try switching networks — e.g. use mobile data or Wi-Fi from elsewhere. In the previous guild event I couldn't tap it on home internet either and had to use mobile data, though Wi-Fi sometimes works.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên đổi mạng để thư cam hiện ra.
items.summary_en: Suggests switching networks so the orange letter shows.

items.text_th: ลองมาเล่นใน VNG มั้ยคะ เผื่อขึ้น
items.text_vn: Thử chơi bản VNG xem sao, biết đâu hiện ra
items.text_en: Try playing in the VNG version — maybe it will show up.
items.summary_vn: Gợi ý thử chơi bản VNG để ảnh đại diện hiện lại.
items.summary_en: Suggests trying the VNG version to get the picture back.

items.text_th: ของเราก็เคยเป็นค่ะ เราเลยลองเปลี่ยนรูปที่ facebook สลับไปมาก็ได้เหมือนเดิมแล้วค่ะ
items.text_vn: Mình cũng từng bị, thử đổi ảnh trên Facebook qua lại thì hiện lại như cũ
items.text_en: It happened to me too; I switched my Facebook profile picture back and forth and it returned to normal.
items.summary_vn: Mẹo đổi ảnh Facebook qua lại để ảnh đại diện game hiện lại.
items.summary_en: Tip: switch the Facebook picture back and forth to restore it.
